mapper.select: SELECT effect FROM sys_user_permission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND permission_id = #{permissionId}
SELECT permission_id, effect FROM sys_user_permission WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY permission_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_permission (id, user_id, permission_id, effect) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{permissionId}, #{effect})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_user_permission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND permission_id = #{permissionId}
